row.title: Q-GATE-403: the App asks for statuses:write; an all-403 gate is one card
row.body: The GitHub App manifest never requested the statuses permission, so the Worker gate was answered 403 on every pull request. SCOPE_ALLOWLIST now includes statuses: write, checkRepoAccess reports permissions the installation lacks, and runGate returns status forbidden with needs statuses:write, which the tick keeps as the single gate card GATE-APP-PERMISSION (default in effect: the lane merges on local-checks evidence). An App registered before this change needs the owner's one approval of the new permission at /connect/github.
